title: Smart seat tail mode is merged (opt-in, off by default). Turn it on per session

owner_note.text: Smart seat tail mode is merged (opt-in, off by default). Turn it on per session with POST /api/session/settings {session, tail: true}. It needs a Servex restart, at a time you pick, not during a call. The old wake rules stay until a live call proves it. Details: /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/wake-policy.md
